entities.summary: Miguel A. Torres is a Spanish winemaker, author and businessman. He is the owner, president and managing director of Bodegas Torres, and is a member of the fourth generation of this family business. He also manages the company’s vineyards in Chile and collaborates with his sister Marimar Torres in California. Additionally, Torres is the co-founder of the International Wineries Climate Association (IWCA).
